resources.name: campaign_booklet
resources.description: Enriched campaign booklet artifact using the same document-row universe as the original CSV source, with conservative NEC linkage fields such as 'huboid', 'sg_id', and 'sg_typecode' added to improve interoperability with kr-elections-mcp and related NEC-aligned workflows.
resources.recommended_for: NEC-aligned workflows, kr-elections-mcp, and linkage-aware joins.

resources.name: party_statements
resources.description: Official statements from party spokespersons and minutes from daily leadership meetings of South Korea's two major parties (Conservative and Progressive), covering 2003 to 2022. 83,201 total entries (35,115 conservative + 48,086 progressive). Parsed using the khaiii Korean morphological analyzer.
